name: Italy
standard: AgID Linee guida sull'accessibilità degli strumenti informatici (reference EN 301 549 / WCAG 2.1 AA)

laws.cite: Legge 9 gennaio 2004, n. 4 (Legge Stanca), as amended by D.Lgs. 106/2018
laws.summary: Public administrations must make IT tools, websites and apps accessible; the law was amended to transpose the WAD.

applies_to: Public administrations and other entities in scope of Legge 4/2004 art. 3; separate AgID guidelines extend duties to large private companies under art. 3 c.1-bis.

deadlines.what: Annual deadline to publish or update the dichiarazione di accessibilità via AgID Form
Next annual deadline to publish accessibility objectives (every 31 March)

exceptions: WAD exceptions and disproportionality, per the guidelines
requires: Accessibility statement via form.agid.gov.it under the Digital Transition Manager, updated annually by 23 September
Publish annual accessibility objectives by 31 March
Accessibility checks, including for contracts above EU thresholds
mobile: explicit — the guidelines cover websites and mobile apps.
procurement: The guidelines require accessibility verification in procurement (contracts above EU thresholds).
enforcement: AgID monitors samples and reports to the Commission every 3 years. The Difensore civico per il digitale (at AgID) handles reports of statement or monitoring failures.
notes: The 23 Sep and 31 Mar deadlines and the Difensore civico role come from search-result summaries of agid.gov.it pages. The Normattiva URN was not opened. The D.Lgs. 106/2018 date is not verified. The AgID guidelines page was last updated 2023-05-29.
